sql: CREATE TABLE ci_student(id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE ci_course(term INTEGER, code VARCHAR(8), title VARCHAR(24) UNIQUE, PRIMARY KEY(term,code))

CREATE TABLE ci_enrol(sid BIGINT, term INTEGER, code VARCHAR(8), mark INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(sid,term,code), CONSTRAINT ci_score CHECK(mark>=0 AND mark<=100), CONSTRAINT ci_fk_s FOREIGN KEY(sid) REFERENCES ci_student(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT ci_fk_c FOREIGN KEY(term,code) REFERENCES ci_course(term,code) ON DELETE RESTRICT)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ci_enrol

SELECT e.sid,s.name,c.title,e.mark FROM ci_enrol e JOIN ci_student s ON e.sid=s.id JOIN ci_course c ON e.term=c.term AND e.code=c.code ORDER BY e.sid
SELECT code,COUNT(*),COUNT(mark),SUM(mark) FROM ci_enrol GROUP BY code ORDER BY code
SELECT sid FROM ci_enrol WHERE mark=90 ORDER BY mark,sid LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
